name: Classic Minimalist UI & Design System Auditor
description: Evaluates HTML/CSS/UI components against classic minimalist design principles: restrained color palette, subtle borders, high typographic hierarchy, adequate whitespace/density, and absence of visual clutter.

uiSourceCode.description: HTML, CSS, React JSX, or Blazor razor component markup.
